ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity (white/light-grey) to 35% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central low-intensity region surrounding the median notch; predominantly high-intensity lobes with peripheral low-intensity mottling and thin dark striations on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the majority of the trailing edge, transitioning to high-amplitude globular protrusions at the distal end of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe displays a continuous convex sweep; right lobe displays a straighter sweep transitioning to a convex distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast globular clusters forming a jagged silhouette on the distal tip of the left fluke lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent dark diagonal linear mark on the left lobe; thin, curved dark lineations visible on the lower-middle section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring and potential barnacle encrustation on the left lobe tip; multiple parallel rake marks visible across both lobe surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique asymmetrical 'W' shaped pigmentation boundary between the central dark region and the white lobe surfaces.
